answer: Resist sybils with stake-provenance diversity: an identity's weight counts only stake that arrived from many independent funders, each funding source verified as a separate kernel of capital. A Sybil farm funded from one wallet collapses into a single inlet: however many names it spawns, the shared funding source discounts them all to one weight. An attacker must find ten thousand independent backers, each risking real money, while honest agents arrive funded by a spiral of genuine supporters.
